data.one_liner: Create loading cards with smooth color transition animations in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: The package provides a `CardLoading` widget that helps create loading skeleton cards transitioning between two colors. It includes customizable properties such as height, border radius, and margin.
use_when: You need to display loading states for cards or placeholder content.
You want an easy way to animate loading views between two colors.
avoid_when: You need complex multi-element skeleton screens layout builders which are better served by standard shimmer packages.
strengths: Easy to use with simple configuration.
Supports customizable border radius and margins.
Cross-platform support across Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond basic property usage.
Relatively basic feature set compared to broader shimmer or skeleton packages.

alternatives.name: shimmer
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need standard shimmer effects for generic loading placeholders.

data.minimal_example:
CardLoading(
  height: 100,
  borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(10)),
  margin: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
)
